name_en: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC / ST / SCC Students
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Students from Class 11 up to college get a monthly scholarship: Rs 100 to 175 a month if you live at home, Rs 175 to 350 a month if you stay in a hostel. Tuition fees are fully waived.

other: Must be studying in Class 11 or higher, up to college
